attributes.title: ONL's 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.venue: The Omni Mount Washington Resort and Spa
attributes.cme_provider: Organization of Nurse Leaders - New England
attributes.organizer: Organization of Nurse Leaders - New England
attributes.summary:
The Organization of Nurse Leaders - New England holds its 2027 Annual Meeting on June 17 and 18, 2027, at the Omni Mount Washington Resort in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire. The program combines sessions with nationally known speakers, a vendor area and ONL's business meeting.

ONL is approved as a provider of nursing continuing professional development by ANA Massachusetts, an ANCC-accredited approver; the number of contact hours is not published yet. Registration is open at $499 for members and $749 for non-members, which includes a year of membership.
